title: Restriction of a rectifiable triple to a Borel set (Simon Ch. 6, 3.1; integer multiplicity of T⌞A)
statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ and let (M, θ, ξ) satisfy IsRectifiableTriple univ k M θ ξ (Simon Ch. 6, 3.1 in U = ℝ^N: M is μHE[k]-null-measurable and countably k-rectifiable, θ > 0 on M and locally μHE[k]-integrable on M, ξ is μHE[k]⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable, and for μHE[k]⌞M-a.e. x, ξ(x) = ±τ₁∧⋯∧τ_k for an orthonormal τ spanning a weighted approximate tangent space of (M, θ) at x). Let A ⊆ ℝ^N be a Borel set. Then IsRectifiableTriple univ k (M ∩ A) θ ξ.
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl N)) (θ : Eucl N → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k) (A : Set (Eucl N)), IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k M θ ξ → MeasurableSet A → IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k (M ∩ A) θ ξ
